CREATIVE ARTS AND SPORTS — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #6
====

GRADE: Grade 8
SUBJECT: CREATIVE ARTS AND SPORTS
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KJSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Best practice when working on Drawing and Painting: (1 mark)
   A. Disrupt classmates during Drawing and Painting.
   B. Practise Drawing and Painting with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   C. Refuse all feedback on Drawing and Painting.
   D. Damage equipment used for Drawing and Painting.

2. Primary colours are: (1 mark)
   A. Red, blue, and yellow
   B. Black, white, and grey
   C. Brown, pink, and gold
   D. Green, orange, and purple

   B. The ticket price
   C. Only the costume

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. In three clear sentences, explain Analysis of Creative Arts and Sports 8 Total Number of Lessons 150 Note: The sug and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
